subject.title: fix: gate Gateway message action requester provenance [AI]

question: Should this PR establish the permanent Gateway `message.action` requester-provenance boundary, including an admin-scoped trusted backend bridge that downscopes channel-handler authorization to write scope?
rationale: The patch changes an authorization-sensitive RPC boundary and the scope contract observed by channel handlers, so implementation review cannot substitute for owner acceptance of the security and upgrade behavior.

options.title: Require repair, proof, and owner acceptance
options.body: Fix the admin-upscope compatibility blocker, add redacted live Gateway proof for write-scope stripping and trusted bridge preservation, then have a Gateway/security owner accept the boundary.

options.title: Accept the admin bridge deliberately
options.body: Maintainers can own the stricter admin requirement for requester-carrying bridge calls after documenting affected credentials and requester-dependent actions.

options.title: Pause for a different boundary
options.body: Hold or close this branch if trusted requester provenance should be solved with a different Gateway or channel-action API.

recommendation.title: Require repair, proof, and owner acceptance
recommendation.body: Fix the admin-upscope compatibility blocker, add redacted live Gateway proof for write-scope stripping and trusted bridge preservation, then have a Gateway/security owner accept the boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the best available routing candidate because CONTRIBUTING.md lists them for both Gateway and Security.
